user.title: Hejhome Open API
user.description: Enter the API key issued in the Hejhome partners portal ({portal_url}). Each user needs their own key and must link their own Hejhome account to the application.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {title} no longer works. Issue a new key in the partners portal ({portal_url}), enter it here, then revoke the old key.

reconfigure.title: Change API key
reconfigure.description: Enter the new API key for {title}. Revoke the old key in the partners portal ({portal_url}) after this succeeds.

error.invalid_auth: The API key is wrong or has been revoked.
error.ip_not_allowed: This IP is not in the application's allowed IP list. Check the allowed IPs in the partners portal.
error.organization_inactive: The organization is not approved or is inactive.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Hejhome Open API.
error.no_linked_account: No Hejhome account is linked to this application. Link your account in the partners portal first.
error.account_unavailable: The linked Hejhome account is unavailable. Re-link it in the partners portal.
error.no_home: No home owned by the linked account was found.
error.wrong_home: This API key cannot see the configured home.

abort.wrong_home: This API key cannot see the configured home.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds, 30 to 300. Shorter intervals use more of the API rate limit.
data_description.device_refresh_hours: Hours. New and removed devices are picked up at this interval.

invalid_auth.message: The API key is wrong or has been revoked.

ip_not_allowed.message: This IP is not in the application's allowed IP list. Check the allowed IPs in the partners portal.

organization_inactive.message: The organization is not approved or is inactive.

rate_limited.message: Rate limited by the Hejhome Open API; retrying in {seconds} s.

device_not_ready.message: The device is not ready ({error}). Try again shortly.

rate_limited.title: Hejhome Open API rate limit reached often
rate_limited.description: {title} hit the API rate limit several times in the last hour. Increase the polling interval in the integration options.

ip_not_allowed.title: Hejhome Open API: IP not allowed
ip_not_allowed.description: Requests for {title} are rejected because Home Assistant's public IP is not in the application's allowed IP list. Your public IP may have changed. Update the allowed IPs in the partners portal (https://partners.goqual.com).

organization_inactive.title: Hejhome Open API: organization inactive
organization_inactive.description: Requests for {title} are rejected because the organization is not approved or is inactive. Check the partners portal.
